integrity: The conclusion is a directly proved nonrealizability statement independent of any freeness test; finite checks support but do not replace the symbolic proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Excludes only the all-ordinary-triple (6,1;0,0,9) degree-eight conic–line type.
Does not decide other nearly-free conic–line types in degrees eight or nine.
Unindexed classical equivalent incidence results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Six-line incidence obstruction to a pure-triple degree-eight conic arrangement
